text: dsh-download-progress 为 DSH 网页端提供下载进度显示。服务端读取任务状态，客户端在聊天窗口右上角展示百分比、文件大小、速度、剩余时间和阶段，并支持取消及终态自动收起。随附下载技能可预探测文件大小、估算耗时，并在中断后重连或续传。任务数据保存在本机；需要 DSH Web 和 Node.js 18 或更新版本。

dsh-download-progress adds download tracking to DSH Web. A chat card shows percentage, size, speed, ETA, and phase, with cancellation and auto-dismissal. The downloader estimates duration, retries stalled transfers, and resumes interrupted downloads. Task data stays local; requires Node.js 18+.
我想让 DSH 下载大文件时能看到实时进度。
下载文件的时候能显示速度和还要多久吗？
让聊天窗口右上角显示当前下载任务。
下载中途断了，怎么从已有进度继续？
Show me the progress and ETA while DSH downloads a file.
Can I resume a download after it gets interrupted?
「实时进度卡片」：在 DSH 网页聊天窗口右上角显示文件名、百分比、已下载大小、总大小、速度和剩余时间；活动任务自动刷新。
「取消下载」：点击或键盘操作进度卡片上的按钮即可取消活动任务；终态卡片可关闭。客户端向本地取消接口提交任务 ID。
「断点续传」：下载中断或取消后，可通过技能的 resume 命令继续任务；遇到传输停滞时下载器会自动重连尝试续传。
「下载预估与任务查询」：启动任务前通过 HEAD 或 Range 探测文件大小，并利用站点历史速度估算耗时；status 命令可查看任务状态。
下载失败后我想接着未完成的部分继续，而不是重新开始。
Can the download tool show transferred bytes, speed, and estimated time remaining?

dsh-download-progress README · dsh-download-progress：**Live download progress for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) — no more staring at a silent chat while the agent downloads a 1 GB installer.**

> Same UI in light theme: [`docs/screenshot-light.png`](docs/screenshot-light.png)

The cards in the top-right corner are rendered by this plugin's client half (`lib/client.js`); the numbers come from the real download worker (`skills/download-progress/scripts/dl.mjs`).

dsh-download-progress README · Features：- 💬 **Live progress card in the top-right of the chat window** — percentage, bar, downloaded / total, instantaneous speed, **ETA**, and current phase (probe → connect → download → reconnect → done). Cancel with one click; finished cards auto-collapse.
- 📏 **Pre-flight probe** — `dl start` resolves total size first, then estimates duration from the per-host speed history.
- 🔁 **Resumable** — automatic reconnect-and-resume after a 20 s stall (up to 8 attempts); after cancel/failure, `dl resume` continues from the `.part` file.
- 🩹 **Self-healing cards** — if the worker dies (crash, killed shell), the card greys out as *interrupted* within 6 s and the status is healed to `failed` in 20 s, so nothing hangs on screen forever.
- 📦 **Zero dependencies, zero host patching** — plain cordis plugin (`cordis.patch.yml`), client half auto-injected through the `./client` export, Node ≥ 18 standard library only. All data stays on your machine.

dsh-download-progress README · Install：From the DSH plugin market (once listed): search `dsh-download-progress` → install → restart DSH.

Manual install from this repo:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Beership/dsh-download-progress.git
cd dsh-download-progress && npm pack          # -> dsh-download-progress-0.3.2.tgz
```

Then in `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` add the package to `dependencies` and to `dsh.profile.bundles`, extract the tarball into that profile's `node_modules/dsh-download-progress`, and restart DSH.
dsh-download-progress README · Install：Prefer the prebuilt tarball: <https://github.com/Beership/dsh-download-progress/releases/download/v0.3.2/dsh-download-progress-0.3.2.tgz>

dsh-download-progress README · Usage：After install + restart, just ask in a session:

> Download https://example.com/electron-v33.2.0-win32-x64.zip to `D:\Downloads` and show live progress

The agent calls the bundled skill, a worker starts in the background, and every `dl.mjs` download (from any agent/session) shows up on the progress cards.

CLI, if you want to drive it yourself:

dsh-download-progress README · Usage：```bash
node dl.mjs start <URL> --dir D:\Downloads   # background, returns a job id immediately
node dl.mjs status [--json]                  # progress of all jobs
node dl.mjs wait <id>                        # block until finished
node dl.mjs cancel <id>                      # keep the .part for later

dsh-download-progress README · How it works：```
agent session
  └─ dl.mjs (bundled skill script, Node stdlib)
       ├─ probe: HEAD/Range → size + ETA estimate from per-host history
       ├─ worker: writes ~/.agent-downloads/jobs/<id>/status.json every 250 ms

dsh-download-progress README · Why the worker is launched through WMI on Windows：A one-shot command executor (DSH's `ops_bash` and friends) kills the whole process tree it spawned as soon as the command returns — a `detached` child included, via a Windows job object. On Windows the worker is therefore spawned by `Win32_Process.Create` through `WmiPrvSE`, whose parent is outside that job object; on POSIX `detached: true` (`setsid`) is enough. Because WMI children do not inherit the caller's environment, the job home is passed explicitly as `--home`.
section: Why the worker is launched through WMI on Windows

dsh-download-progress README · 0.3.2：- Job home is passed to the worker as `--home` — fixes downloads that stayed at `queued/probe` when `AGENT_DL_HOME` was customized (WMI children inherit the provider's environment, not the caller's).
- `status --json` always prints valid JSON (`[]` when there is no job).
- Filename falls back to the URL path when the server sends no `Content-Disposition`.
- Card: reconnect shows `重连中…` instead of `测速中…`; `✕` is keyboard accessible (`role=button`, Enter/Space); fewer needless re-renders; `dismissed` set is capped.
- Skill installation is skipped when the version is unchanged, so local edits survive restarts.
- Added smoke tests, a screenshot generator and CI.

dsh-download-progress README · 0.3.1：- **Root cause of “stuck at 3 % / cards never disappear”**: the executor reclaimed the worker's process tree right after `dl start` returned, so `status.json` stopped updating. Fixed by launching the worker through WMI on Windows (`Win32_Process.Create`) and `setsid` on POSIX.
- Status writes retry and fall back to a plain overwrite on `EPERM/EBUSY` (Windows rename contention).
- Adaptive polling, client-side 6 s staleness detection, terminal cards auto-collapse (4 s done / 12 s failed or cancelled, paused while hovering).

dsh-download-progress README · 使用：安装并重启后，在会话里直接说：

> 下载 https://registry.npmmirror.com/-/binary/electron/33.2.0/electron-v33.2.0-win32-x64.zip 到 D:\Downloads，实时显示进度

聊天窗口右上角会出现悬浮进度条（文件名/百分比/速度/剩余时间/阶段），agent 同时在聊天里播报关键节点。所有通过 `dl.mjs` 发起的下载（无论哪个 agent）都会显示在进度条上。

dsh-download-progress README · 工作原理：```
agent（DSH 会话）
  └─ 调用 dl.mjs（技能内脚本，Node ≥18 零依赖）
       ├─ 预探测：HEAD/Range 请求拿文件大小 + 按站点历史速度估算耗时
       ├─ 后台下载：进度写入 ~/.agent-downloads/jobs/<id>/status.json

- 插件为标准 cordis 插件：`cordis.patch.yml` 声明插入，`./client` 导出自动进入 Web 客户端，**不改宿主任何文件**，随 DSH 升级无需重新打补丁。
- 只使用 Node 标准库，无任何 npm 运行时依赖；任务数据只存本机，不外传。

dsh-download-progress README · 开发与测试：```bash
npm test              # node --test：本地 HTTP 夹具，不联网、不需要外网
npm run screenshot    # 用真实 client.js 重新生成 docs/screenshot-*.png
npm run pack:check    # 查看打进 tgz 的文件
```

dsh-download-progress README · 0.3.2 — 开源准备：- 任务根目录改为通过 `--home` 显式传给 worker：WMI 代启的子进程继承的是 WmiPrvSE 的环境，自定义 `AGENT_DL_HOME` 会丢，任务永远停在 `queued/probe`（新增冒烟测试抓到的真实 bug）。
- `status --json` 恒输出合法 JSON（无任务时输出 `[]`），不再混入中文提示。
- 服务端没给 `Content-Disposition` 时，文件名回退到 URL 路径，不再一律 `download-<id>.bin`。
- 卡片：断流重连显示「重连中…」而不是「测速中…」；✕ 支持键盘（role=button / Enter / Space）；减少无意义重绘；`dismissed` 集合加上限。
- 技能安装改为版本一致即跳过，避免每次重启覆盖用户对 SKILL.md 的本地修改。
- 新增 `test/`（4 个用例，覆盖下载/续传/取消/clean）、`scripts/screenshot.mjs` 截图生成器、GitHub Actions CI。

dsh-download-progress README · 0.3.1 — 修复「进度条卡在 3% / 卡片不消失」：- **根因**：Agent 通过一次性命令执行器（`ops_bash` 之类）调用 `dl start`，命令一返回，执行器就回收该命令派生的整棵进程树（Windows 作业对象 / POSIX 进程组），于是 `detached spawn` 出来的下载 worker 也被顺带杀掉 — `status.json` 不再刷新，界面永远停在杀进程那一刻。
- **修复**：Windows 下改由 WMI（`Win32_Process.Create`）代启 worker，父进程变成 `WmiPrvSE`，脱离该作业对象；POSIX 仍用 `setsid`（`detached` 本身）。已实测：worker 在启动它的命令返回后继续跑完整个 178 MB / 100 MB 下载。
- **状态写入**：`rename` 遭遇 `EPERM/EBUSY`（Windows 上读侧同时打开文件）时重试并退化为直接覆盖写，避免某一次写失败导致进度永久冻结。
- **界面**：轮询改为自适应（有卡片 450 ms / 空屏 1.5 s，后台标签页暂停）；客户端按 `updatedAt` 自行判定「已中断」（6 s），不再依赖宿主 60 s 自愈；**终态卡片自动收起**（完成 4 s、失败/取消 12 s，鼠标悬停时暂停）。
- **启动健壮性**：`dl start/resume` 会先建好目标目录，启动失败直接落盘 `failed` 并给出原因，不再留一个永远 `queued` 的僵尸任务。
section: 0.3.1 — 修复「进度条卡在 3% / 卡片不消失」
